issues.reason: Capturing seizes an otherwise unaltered entity, so the change test plus the instruction set's own "abducting a diplomat relocates something unchanged -> Theme" ruling (and the "when the test is unclear, default to Theme" fallback) make Patient a claim of change the text never states.

The Experiencer prescription belongs to the attitude construction, which is explicitly "only for a finite clausal complement" — "claim to have taken" is a to-infinitive control complement, which the instruction set routes to the non-finite-complement pattern where "the matrix verb keeps its own surface lemma and roles", and the progressive test ("is claiming" is fine) makes that role Agent; "said" with its clausal complement is the finite case, so the two differ by rule, not by inconsistency.

gaps_confirmed: Direct quotation as a speech verb's complement — the attitude section covers finite that-clauses only, so whether verbatim quoted speech seals as a proposition or is recorded as an utterance is undetermined.

A compound kind whose modifier is a proper noun ("the White House press secretary") — the compound rules want the modifier left in the fused symbol while the naming rules require a capitalized run to get its own symbol and Name.
new_gaps: A complex preposition heading an event oblique ("in terms of") — the CamelCase-joined multiword head is licensed by analogy with multiword locative prepositions, but nothing states that a non-spatial complex preposition takes the preposition-named oblique route.

A perfect infinitive under a control verb ("claim to have taken") — the non-finite-complement rule says the complement carries no status atom "unless its own grammar marks one", and it is undetermined whether perfect-infinitive morphology counts as such a marker (the parse emits Past plus a within-seal Before).
repair_summary: Inside the sealed complement, (Patient sk_capture_1 al_qaida) becomes (Theme sk_capture_1 al_qaida); nothing else changed.
notes: The gap-territory improvisations — sealing the quotation under say, the fused white_house_press_secretary with its secretary genus, and the InTermsOf oblique — all emit only atoms true of the sentence, so they stand under the calibration line. (Member sk_step_1 insufficient) reads as a property of the collection of steps (whether the steps taken suffice), which is the one licensed use of a bare Member on a group symbol.
